{{Top|leg}}
'''Sewalian algae crisps''' were a type of snack from the [[Sewalia system/Legends|Sewalia system]] that was popular with [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] around [[139 ABY]]. [[Ania Solo]] offered to serve her lover [[Ramid]] some algae crisps after she and her companions had rescued his [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. Shortly later, Ania was kidnapped by Ramid.
